title: [ACT] Project Arcadia - Vacuity 0.1.0 [ENG-UNCEN]
description:
**Gameplay:**
In arcade mode to interact with Avatar-chan you need to pickup drops. Currently, we have Pink and Blue pickups that do that, their level can be seen in bottom right of the screen. For the eye candy you need to pickup Blue pill, that dissolves thing. Such of action causes distress and leads to gameover. To calm things down, you need to take Pink pill.
Iterations - to give you as many chances as you need to collect everything, iterations were created. You can replay given level as much as you need, be aware that every time it gets a bit harder, and a bit weirder. Currently there is only One level.

**Extras:**
To unlock sliders, you need to progress gameplay, to unlock animations you need corresponding event to happen. All possible animations ale listed on the right side of the screen.

**Upgrades:**
Life: How many additional lifes you have.
Damage: Gives a small boost to damage.
Speed: The idea was to limit speed of the player spaceship. For now is disabled.
Attack Speed: Gives a small boost to attack speed.
Pink Chance: Incerases chance for Pink pickable.
Blue Chance: Incerases chance for a Blue pickable.
Gold Value:  Dropped gold has more value. 
Powerup Chance: Incerases chance of powerup spawn.
Powerup Value: Incerases how potent powerup is.

**Key configuration:**
Arcade Mode:
W S A D SPACEBAR or Mouse and Left button - ship control.
F1 F2 F3 F4 - camera control.
Extra mode:

Right muse button and Middle mouse button - rotate camera
Scroll wheel - zoom in/zoom out.
F5 Help
